description: This Java class 'SubjectsModifiedStrategy' implements a specific event handling strategy for 'SubjectsModified' events within the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides the 'applyEvent' method to modify policy entries based on the event data.

classes.name: SubjectsModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyEventStrategy specialized for 'SubjectsModified' events to implement custom policy update logic.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to process 'SubjectsModified' events, updating the policy with new subjects information or existing entries based on event details.
